citation: SGD S288C genome (PMID:9169870 chrIX seq; PMID:24374639 reannotation)
claim_tested: YIL164C and YIL165C are two parts of one reading frame
key_finding: YIL164C chrIX 34,087-34,686 and YIL165C 33,718-34,077 (Crick), start-to-start offset 609 nt (0 mod 3); junction CCT ATT TAG | AGG ACT GTG | ATG; read-through gives one 969-nt/322-codon ORF with no internal stop
confidence_limits: High. Direct from reference sequence. Does not by itself show the read-through allele exists.

citation: SGD strain sequence panel (29 YIL164C entries)
claim_tested: The locus is intact in other S. cerevisiae strains
key_finding: 6 strains (EC1118, YJM789, T7, CLIB215, YJM269, ZTW1) have a 969-nt single ORF with TGG(Trp) at codon 200; 3 more (JAY291, VIN13, BC187) read through codon 200; 15 strains carry TAG
context: S. cerevisiae strain assemblies in SGD
confidence_limits: High for the strains present. Strain panel is small and biased to lab/industrial isolates; the 1011-genomes allele frequency was not queried.

claim_tested: A full-length S. cerevisiae Nit1 protein entry exists
key_finding: 322-aa protein annotated 'Nitrilase', identical to the reconstructed read-through protein except residue 91 (S/G)
context: UniProt TrEMBL, S. cerevisiae RM11-1a proteome
confidence_limits: High as a database record; it is an automatic gene prediction, not a characterised protein.

claim_tested: Related Saccharomyces species carry a single intact ORF
key_finding: S. mikatae, S. kudriavzevii, S. uvarum and S. pastorianus orthologs are all 322 aa (90-99% identity) with Trp200 and E44/K135/C169 intact
confidence_limits: High. All are automatic annotations from genome assemblies.

claim_tested: The intact Nit1-branch gene predates Saccharomyces
key_finding: 323-aa single ORF, 73.2% identical to the reconstructed ScNit1 and only 25.8% to ScNit2 (NW scores 1252 vs 96)
confidence_limits: High for the orthology call. Function of the Lachancea protein is itself uncharacterised.

citation: AlphaFold DB AF-P40447, AF-P40446, AF-C5DH06; phenix.superpose_pdbs
claim_tested: The YIL164C fragment is a self-sufficient catalytic unit
key_finding: YIL164C model superposes on C5DH06 residues 1-200 at RMSD 0.595 A; YIL165C model on 201-323 at RMSD 0.988 A; 1,621 heavy-atom contacts <5 A between the halves; Trp201 (=Sc Trp200) is 3.33 A from the catalytic Cys
confidence_limits: Moderate-to-high. Models, not experimental structures; no experimental structure of any Nit1-branch yeast protein was found.

claim_tested: The curated view already flags a pseudogene
key_finding: 'Could be the product of a pseudogene. NIT1/YIL164C seems to be the N-terminal part of a putative nitrilase-like protein formed of NIT1/YIL164C and YIL165C'; protein existence 5 (Uncertain)
confidence_limits: Database-level support, ECO:0000305 inferred by curator.

citation: SGD locus descriptions for YIL164C and YIL165C
key_finding: 'in closely related species and other S. cerevisiae strain backgrounds YIL164C and adjacent ORF, YIL165C, likely constitute a single ORF encoding a nitrilase gene'; both still typed 'Verified ORF'
confidence_limits: Database-level. The 'Verified ORF' feature type conflicts with the description text.

claim_tested: Which yeast gene carries Nit1-type activity
key_finding: The yeast ortholog of mammalian Nit1 is a deaminated-glutathione amidase; in S. cerevisiae this is NIT2/YJL126W (P47016), which carries GO:0110050 IDA
context: Yeast and human cells, purified enzyme, metabolite measurements
confidence_limits: High for Nit2. Does not address YIL164C; names in yeast are inverted relative to mammals.

citation: PMID:10959838 (Pace et al. 2000) via GO:0000257 ISA
key_finding: GO:0000257 on P40447 is ISA (ECO:0000247) with UniProtKB:P32961, Arabidopsis nitrilase 1, a true-nitrilase branch-1 enzyme, transferred onto a 199-aa Nit-branch fragment
context: GO annotation record retrieved from QuickGO
confidence_limits: Low support for the term. Cross-branch transfer plus fragment target.

key_finding: yil165c-delta was one of 32 mitophagy-defective hits; only ylr356w-delta (ATG33) was characterised further
context: BY4741 deletion collection, Om45-GFP processing assay
confidence_limits: Low. Unvalidated screen hit at a pseudogenic interval; GO:0000422 and GO:0016236 IMP rest on it.

claim_tested: Is either ORF translated in S288C
key_finding: 0 protein-abundance experiments and 0 expression records for YIL164C and YIL165C; all 9 and 22 phenotypes respectively are from deletion-collection screens
confidence_limits: Absence of evidence. PeptideAtlas cross-reference exists on P40447 but no peptide-level check was performed here.
